items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: Willie, I played with Willie. Willie came out here and we were working someplace and he worked a week or two somewhere out here. We were using two clarinets.

ctx.x: No, his cousin. Your cousin? Yeah, his son used to play clandest. Yeah, Willie. Pop-up. No, no, old man. See, Willie was... Uh...
Umphreys. The Percy Umpers plays coronet now as the leader of the Eureka Band. Oh, is it? Yeah, sure. We first cousins.
